description: This file defines a static class ApiErrorHandling that provides centralized exception handling middleware for ASP.NET Core Web API applications. It converts uncaught exceptions into RFC7807 ProblemDetails responses, maps specific exceptions to HTTP status codes, and logs errors appropriately. The class includes methods to register middleware, convert exceptions to results, and map exceptions to status, title, and detail information.

classes.name: ApiErrorHandling
classes.description: Provides static methods for registering global exception handling middleware and converting exceptions into standardized HTTP responses with ProblemDetails.

methods.name: UseUnifiedExceptionHandling
methods.description: Registers middleware to handle exceptions globally, catching unhandled exceptions and converting them to appropriate HTTP responses.

methods.name: ToResult
methods.description: Converts an exception into an IResult containing a ProblemDetails response, with special handling for validation exceptions and logging.
